title: Realization of two successive finite projection components
statement: For a finite operation stage S [def-sf-operation-stages], composable maps f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, arbitrary compactifications cf,cg, bounded constructible K on X and finite-Tor constructible L on Z [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates], the iteration PF_g followed by S_g(PF_f) is identified under the explicitly constructed iterationSourceComparison and iterationTargetComparison with the realization of the iteration of the two published fixed-scalar projection components. The comparisons are composites of supportRealization, fixedSupportRealization, the inverse coefficient-unit at the tensor input, and the two fixedPullRealization maps. No compact-support compositor or projection for fg appears.

source.place: Composition sentence: realization of the same specified projection maps and support compositors.

proof.text: Expand both components as the conjugates defining component. Move the inner component through the outer support realization by naturality. Cancel the intermediate coefficient unit with its inverse.

Apply first-input naturality of the outer fixed projection to fixedSupportRealization for f, and second-input naturality of the inner fixed projection to fixedPullRealization for g. Tensor bifunctoriality interchanges the two independent input comparisons. Functoriality identifies the remaining boundary with iterationSourceComparison and iterationTargetComparison. This uses no composite-map projection or support compositor. Use unitTensorRealization to give the same inverse-unit and tensor factors with explicit endpoints before specializing the coefficient equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Explicit coefficient-unit cancellation, using the typed generic unitTensorRealization construction in the composition sentence.

lean.statement:
theorem iteration_realization :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n hn
    let RX := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) X
    let RZ := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) Z
    let G := sfFixedCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n) cg
    let Pg := fixedDerivedPull (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) g
    let k := RX.inverse.obj K.obj
    let l := RZ.inverse.obj L.obj
    let I := (intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible C.l E n hn Z.obj.left).ι
    I.map (component S g cg ((S.finite.support f cf).obj K) L ≫
        (S.finite.support g cg).map (component S f cf K ((torPull S g).obj L))) ≫
      (iterationTargetComparison S f g cf cg K L).hom =
    (iterationSourceComparison S f g cf cg K L).hom ≫
      RZ.functor.map
        (fixedComponent (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) g cg
          ((sfFixedCompactSupport (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E n) cf).obj k) l ≫
          G.map (fixedComponent (C := C) (E := E) (n := n) (hn := hn) f cf k
            (Pg.obj l)))
